notes: new: the giveaway crawler reads the whole Whatnot catalog on its first scan, and scans faster
new: every account holds up to 50 live streams at once - pick which accounts run when you press Start, and change them (or the crawler account) while it is running
new: the crawl feed pins the streams your accounts are really in at the top, in green, most entered first, with why each one was picked
new: accounts follow the host before entering a giveaway
fix: giveaways are picked by most entries and viewers instead of a near-random order; empty slots are filled with the most entered streams
fix: accounts pinned in Per-account proxies now really use that proxy for everything they send while entering; nothing falls back to your own IP when a proxy or settings file cannot be read
fix: manual-login accounts - the address and card you add now stick (it asks for a full name)
fix: sign-in no longer stalls after a crawler scan, more than 8 accounts can enter, and a short network drop no longer reads as a signed-out account
